CameraContext.takePhoto(Object object)

Take Photos.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
quality String normal No Imaging quality.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Valid Values of quality

Valid Value Description
high High quality.
normal Normal quality.
low Low quality.

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object res
Attribute Type Description
tempImagePath String Temporary path (local path) of an image file. For Android, JPG files are supported. For iOS, PNG files are supported.

Sample Code

const ctx = my.createCameraContext('camera');

ctx.takePhoto({
  quality: 'high',
  success (res) {
    console.log (res);
  },
  fail (err) {
    console.log (err);
  }
});
